description: A ChatGPT and Codex plugin for creator memory, second-brain workflows, authentic writing, content production, visual handoff, and session learning.

defaultPrompt: Set up my second brain from these exports and research files.
Recall what my workspace knows about this topic, then create from it.
Save the useful corrections and project state from this session.
interface.longDescription: Creator Workspace helps creators organize ChatGPT and Claude exports, research, project state, and writing preferences into an inspectable second brain. It can retrieve the right context, build and maintain a living wiki, preserve a user’s writing voice, draft and structure social content, plan visual outputs, analyze LinkedIn exports, and carry explicit corrections or project state into future work. The package is skills-only and uses host-native file, Python, web, and connector capabilities only when those capabilities are actually available.

name: creator-workbench
